messages:
julia_support: Hey team — LumenWare just pinged support: they were charged twice for the annual renewal. They paid by PO earlier today and their card cleared later. Customer wants a refund and a corrected VAT invoice for EU reporting. Escalating to billing + finance. Invoice IDs below.

lumenware_csr: Hi, yes — PO #PO-99211 was applied at 08:03 UTC and the card payment hit at 09:01 UTC. We need the refund to show on our end before EOD. 

billing-bot: Received payment events: payment.intent.succeeded -> pi_4Hj8k, webhook delivered (200), then later payment_success for card -> pi_4Hk9m, webhook delivered (200). Both linked to invoice inv_2026-04-LW.

mike_billing: Thx. Can you paste the invoice numbers / payment TXs? I need them for the credit note. Also what region / tax ID for invoicing?

julia_support: Invoice IDs: inv_2026-04-LW-PO (created at renewal via PO flow), inv_2026-04-LW-CC (created by card webhook). Payment TXs: pay_pi_4Hj8k (PO/ERP settlement), pay_pi_4Hk9m (card). Customer VAT: DE123456789. Company: LumenWare GmbH.

jamal_engineering: Quick note from infra: there was a 30s delay in our billing webhook queue around 08:02 UTC due to a retried job. Looks like PO reconciliation completed then duplicate path created a separate invoice. Might be race condition between PO-apply job and auto-charge job. I'll attach logs.

julia_support: Repro steps provided by customer: 1) Generate PO in their ERP and send to our billing email. 2) Our finance webhook marks invoice as 'paid by PO' (status paid). 3) ~1m later card autorenew job sees unpaid subscription and issues card charge — creates second invoice. They said this happened during EU midnight window.

mike_billing: OK. Finance path: we should refund the later card charge (pay_pi_4Hk9m) and issue a credit note for the duplicated invoice. For VAT in EU we must create a credit_note referencing the original invoice and then re-issue a single invoice that includes PO as payment source. I'll handle credit_note creation and reissue.

finance_ann: I will create a credit note and mark the inv_2026-04-LW-CC as reversed. Steps I will run: 
- create credit_note for inv_2026-04-LW-CC (reason: duplicate charge)
- refund card TX pay_pi_4Hk9m via payments console (refund_tx: rf_2026-8521)
- reissue consolidated invoice referencing PO and include VAT details (DE123456789).

mike_billing: Please confirm whether customer wants a full refund to card or a credit to account. They requested refund to card in thread.

lumenware_csr: Refund to card please. Need the refund TX id for our reconciliation.

finance_ann: Done: refund initiated -> rf_2026-8521. Credit note created -> cn_2026-114. New consolidated invoice -> inv_2026-04-LW. Reissue email sent with corrected VAT breakdown. Refund should appear on their card in 3-5 business days.

julia_support: Thanks Ann and Mike. Jamal, can you open an infra ticket to patch the race between PO-apply and autorenew? We should add a short lock on the subscription during PO reconciliation to avoid this.

jamal_engineering: Will do — filing ticket INFRA-2026-77 with logs and suggested fix (optimistic lock + idempotency key on invoice creation).

mike_billing: Closing notes for audit: duplicated invoice created due to webhook timing race. Refund rf_2026-8521 issued, credit note cn_2026-114, final invoice inv_2026-04-LW reissued with VAT DE123456789. Noted in billing ledger.

julia_support: Customer confirmed receipt of reissued invoice email and asked to close. Marking resolved. :white_check_mark:
